summary: The change is correct. It adds the full id 5a734782e76daac9b12bd8833c97a73927c8cf94 to the end of `[history] exempt` in athena.toml, keeps all four existing entries, and puts a comment above the list giving the reason (the squash of PR #14 changes records/ but names no job). It records the exemption as D76 in docs/decisions.md, after D75 and following the structure of D70, with a Provenance section stating that the user supplied the id and it was not checked against history. It also adds a CHANGELOG entry. The brief's deliverables ask for that entry, but criterion 4's wording does not allow it; I note this as a minor inconsistency in the brief. `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` all pass. No code, tests or workflows changed, and nothing private was added. One gap remains: nobody, including me, could confirm the id exists in main's history, because this repository has only two commits.
